role_raw: Microring resonator (ring + bus coupler) with integrated heater
query: phase_shifter heater thermal eo tuning pi coupler Single ring resonator side-coupled to a bus waveguide (directional coupler/evanescent coupling region). Include an integrated heater over/near the ring for thermo-optic tuning; heater details (material/stack, resistance target, contact pads, keepouts) to be specified by PDK. Provide optical ports on the bus waveguide (through and drop optional; if add-drop, include a second bus waveguide). Microring resonator with bus coupler and integrated heater Design a microring resonator coupled to a straight bus waveguide via an integrated directional coupler region, with an integrated heater for thermal tuning of the ring resonance. Thermally tunable microring resonance filter: light couples from bus into ring at resonance; heater shifts resonance wavelength via thermo-optic effect.
